P11-001.title: Hikers at the treeline

P11-003.title: Walker in the valley meadow

P11-004.title: Room, then intertitle

P11-009.action: A young man seen from behind studies himself in a wall mirror, brushes a hand over his face and hair, then holds his own gaze.

P11-010.title: Figure in the open frame
P11-010.action: A silhouetted figure stands hand on hip inside a dark broken window frame, facing sunlit white buildings and fluttering flags.

weight shifts forward, head turns toward the buildings

P12-001.title: Framed certificate in the case
